title: Truth table worksheet
subject: Computing
unit: Spring 1: Binary, safety and Boolean logic
source: Seeded from computing/y8 lesson 7 (Truth table worksheet (pupil PDF))
intro: Lesson 7: Logic gates and truth tables. To understand how AND, OR and NOT gates process binary inputs, shown in truth tables

questions.q: Complete the AND truth table from memory.
questions.model: Teacher lists the four input rows in binary order 00, 01, 10, 11 and applies 'both must be 1'.

questions.q: Which gate: 'the alarm sounds if the window OR the door is opened'?
Core: Complete the truth tables for AND, OR and NOT on the worksheet and draw each symbol.
questions.a: Tables as on the slides; correct symbols.
questions.model: Teacher draws the AND symbol and fills its first row.

questions.q: Extend: Build each gate in the CircuitVerse simulator with two switches and a light. Check every row.
questions.a: Each gate's light matches its truth table.

questions.q: Stretch: A vending machine gives a drink if a coin is inserted AND a button is pressed. Write its truth table and say which gate.
questions.a: AND: output 1 only for coin 1, button 1.

questions.q: OR gate, A = 0, B = 0. Output? A) 0 B) 1
Big question: which gate does a car's interior light use, and why?
questions.a: OR: the light comes on if either door is open.
